I'm considering whether p1 might be interested in a trade instead, since they hold Connecticut, St Charles, States, St James, and Pennsylvania Ave, and could value Vermont in return.

Given my tight cash position, selling Vermont to p3 for around $150 (they'd previously offered $140) could fund house-building on Park Place/Boardwalk later, even though it hands p3 two of the three light blues.
